Now it's your turn to sit down and see if your decisions were the right ones. You will see how your team wears down physically over the ninety minutes, how a player with low morale performs below his level, how an unexpected injury in the 30th minute forces the coach to restructure the team. The transfer market is where great projects are forged and where poorly planned ones die. Every player has a transfer cost and a salary that will impact your accounts throughout the duration of their contract. Signing the star everyone wants can give you an immediate competitive leap, but it can also compromise your ability to strengthen other positions. Would you rather have a star and an unbalanced team, or a well-rounded squad that competes on all fronts? That tension between ambition and sustainability is the heart of the game. Sponsors are another key piece of your financial strategy. As your club grows in reputation and results, new brands will want to associate with you. Each sponsorship contract has its conditions, its duration, and its economic impact. Negotiating well can give you the margin you need to sign that midfielder you're missing. A game under construction, with your voice as a guide FD 27 is in active development and will arrive on Steam in Early Access.
